label: Athlete and entertainer home burglaries and robberies, Seattle area, 2025
area: Seattle, Capitol Hill, Maple Valley and other King County homes, WA

linking_evidence: dark 2011 to 2015 Jeep Grand Cherokee with unique wheels and chrome accents named in charging documents as facilitating the crimes
search warrants for recovery of stolen items from the first defendant's relatives, residences or places he stayed
monthslong investigation involving six police jurisdictions
hundreds of pieces of jewelry recovered in a raid on a South Seattle store after the second defendant's August arrest, including rings believed to belong to the entertainer
prosecutors allege the two defendants went on a burglary spree together
ground_truth.notes: All nine incidents appear in the charging documents or in the prosecutors' account of them, but the sources do not say which defendant each count applies to. Police would not say in August 2025 whether the two defendants worked together, while prosecutors later alleged they did. KOMO's 13 Sep incident list omits the 1 May incident, which KOMO's 6 Jun report includes. The arraignment date of the first defendant is 6 Jun in KOMO and 16 Jun in CBS and FOX 13. A prosecutor said the work was not finished and other participants were not identified. No source mentions plate reader, fingerprint or DNA evidence.

outcome.summary: First defendant charged 6 Jun 2025 with burglary and robbery counts, bail 1 million dollars. Second defendant arrested in Renton in late August and charged with 10 felonies in early September; jewelry recovered in a South Seattle store raid. Later outcomes not found.

data_policy: Public sources only. No suspect or victim names, ages, or exact addresses. Source URLs are kept as published and some contain names.
